visual_requirements.description: Plain male editorial human rendering of Dumuzi, whose accepted quotation says He; bodily appearance and opaque clothing are editorial, with no claimed iconography.
Dark descent into the underworld where Dumuzi takes Inanna’s place and remains half the year; architecture is deliberately unspecified editorial stone.

prompts.A:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of TAMMUZ / DUMUZI, a male Mesopotamian god taking Inanna’s place in the underworld.
ANATOMY: plain human male editorial representation, one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs; imposing adult features, fully opaque ceremonial layered drapery without crown, jewelry, weapons or sacred attributes. Appearance and costume are editorial rather than claimed ancient iconography. [tammuz-c01, tammuz-c05]
MOMENT: a composed commanding downward step into the underworld, shoulders advancing toward the viewer, stern direct downward gaze, one empty hand pressing the heavy cloth against his chest and the other lowered naturally. He bears the weight of the descent with authority, never scrambling, hiking or climbing.
POWER: no documented magical power; the god’s physical presence, descent and weight of the underworld alone produce awe. No magic, no supernatural light, no causally displaced landscape. [tammuz-c05, tammuz-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: very close extreme low-angle half-body frontal confrontation, huge face and sweeping shoulders dominate the square through foreshortening only; normal body size. The heavy drapery makes a solemn powerful triangular silhouette, not a peasant tunic. His stern face remains immediately imposing at 200 pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: a single long amber surface light behind his shoulder, natural narrow rim on the face and cloth, immense dark shadow in the descent, ordinary dust falling from his step.
SURFACE: dense heavy opaque ceremonial woven cloth with broad folds, rough black stone, tactile skin, painterly edges and forceful brushwork.
SETTING: underworld expressed as an immense abstract black stone threshold opening into almost absolute darkness, severe simple planes of stone forming a compressed entrance around his shoulders; architecture is editorial abstraction, not a claim about an ancient Mesopotamian monument. No cave scramble, no ruins tourism, no other figures. [tammuz-c05, tammuz-c06]
MOOD: a god accepting a terrible descent, awe-inspiring, grave and dominating the viewer, never an ordinary man in a cave, never an actor costume portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no crown, horns, weapon, staff, animal or invented iconography; no film/game/anime/comic design; fully opaque clothing, no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
prompts.B:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of TAMMUZ / DUMUZI, the Mesopotamian deity who takes Inanna’s place in the underworld.
ANATOMY: a plain adult male human editorial rendering; one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs; unadorned fully opaque heavy dark woven layers. Appearance and clothing are editorial and do not assert iconography; no crown or sacred attributes. [tammuz-c01, tammuz-c05]
MOMENT: plunging down a steep dark rocky threshold in a powerful diagonal stride, looking back over his shoulder toward the viewer; both empty arms close to his body balancing the descent, heavy opaque garment swept diagonally by bodily motion.
POWER: no documented magical power; awe through the documented underworld descent, physical movement, imposing close framing and natural light only. [tammuz-c05, tammuz-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: camera below and to his front-left, a compressed full-body diagonal composition; his near shoulder and face loom in the upper half while one descending foot fills the lower foreground; ordinary anatomical scale, no size comparison figures. Make his body fill almost the entire square, no distant tiny subject.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low warm shaft from the receding surface opening rakes the cheek and robe edges; walnut-black shadows, natural airborne rock dust.
SURFACE: coarse opaque layered cloth, weathered stone ledges, tactile skin, painterly cinematic realism.
SETTING: a bare unspecified rocky descent into the underworld, no identifiable historic building, no additional people, idols or decoration. [tammuz-c05, tammuz-c06]
MOOD: resolute and awe-inspiring, severe and imposing, a forceful descent rather than standing calmly in costume.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs, normal five-finger human hands; no extra limbs; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; fully opaque layered clothing, no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, weapons, crown, horns, animal transformation, magical body or invented sacred iconography.
